name: FGCS Quantum Resource Benchmark
description: Reproducibility package for a resource-aware weighted Max-Cut benchmark that separates operational target construction, amplitude-amplification configuration, logical resource modeling, ideal-statevector QAOA, classical references, and compiler-locked validation. The package includes exact micro-instance ground truth, connected and structured validation tiers, BBHT unknown-solution-count analysis, fixed-overhead and resource-sensitivity studies, QAOA initialization and objective audits, Qiskit compiler evidence, generated figures/tables, tests, and fail-closed preflight validation. It makes no hardware-speedup or quantum-advantage claim.
